title: Dataset Distillation via Drifting
abstract: arXiv:2611.16642v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier. In this work, we propose a new distillation method that learns a set of samples such that they directly approximate the per-class data distribution. Specifically, we "drift" our distilled data in the latent space of a feature extractor such that they move both toward the real data and away from each other without using a classification objective. We find that our drifted data cover the real distribution significantly better than existing methods while still serving as powerful training samples for classification. translated_title: 基于漂移的数据集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏的任务是学习一小组合成样本，这些样本在用于下游任务时能够有效替代大型真实数据集。虽然自该问题提出以来已有许多解决方案，但其中大多数主要寻求针对分类器来优化蒸馏数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的蒸馏方法，它学习一组样本，使其直接逼近每类的数据分布。具体而言，我们在特征提取器的潜空间中对蒸馏数据进行“漂移”，使其既向真实数据靠近，又彼此远离，而无需使用分类目标。我们发现，我们的漂移数据比现有方法显著更好地覆盖真实分布，同时仍可作为强大的分类训练样本。此外，我们还展示了该方法作为一种可视化工具的用途，以便更好地（摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需分类目标的数据集蒸馏新方法，通过在特征提取器潜空间中使蒸馏样本向真实数据“漂移”并彼此远离，从而直接逼近各类数据分布，显著提升对真实分布的覆盖效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel dataset distillation method without a classification objective, which "drifts" distilled samples in a feature extractor's latent space toward real data and away from each other, directly approximating per-class distributions and significantly improving coverage of the real distribution.
